title: pkix-revocation: Display/source rendering and two signer-discovery conjuncts
description:
## Why

The remaining pkix-revocation survivors after the behavioural clusters are
closed. Lower value than those, listed so the sweep's result is fully
accounted for.

## The survivors

    lib.rs:220:9   Display for OutOfScopeReason -> Ok(())
    lib.rs:603:9   Display for Error -> Ok(())
    lib.rs:695:5   crl_reason_name -> "" / "xyzzy"
    lib.rs:711:9   Error::source -> None
    lib.rs:712:13  delete match arm Self::CrlParseError(e) | Self::OcspParseError(e) in source
    crl.rs:1437    (closed) check_crl_sign
    signer_discovery.rs:178:15  replace += with *= in reaches_self_signed
    signer_discovery.rs:233:13  replace && with || in find_parent
    ocsp.rs:356    (closed) CertID disjunction on the anchor path

`Display for Error` and `crl_reason_name` are the same class
`pkix-chain`'s kind enums were: an error that renders as nothing is a log
line that says a revocation check failed without saying why. One test per
enum, every variant, asserting non-empty and distinct -- the pattern in
`pkix-chain/tests/serde_round_trip.rs::every_kind_renders_distinctly` and
`pkix-identity`'s `identity_error_display_covers_all_variants`.

`Error::source` returning `None` breaks `{:#}`-style chained reporting and
anything walking the chain to find the DER error underneath. The deleted
arm is the one that exposes the parse error, which is the only variant
with a source worth having.

`reaches_self_signed`'s `+=` to `*=` is a loop counter: `*=` leaves it at
zero, so the depth bound never trips and a cyclic issuer graph loops until
something else stops it. Worth checking whether the cycle is otherwise
bounded before deciding how to test it.

`find_parent`'s `&&` to `||` relaxes a two-part parent test to either
part, which is the same shape as the AIA orphan predicate's conjuncts
closed in pkix-chain.

## Found by

The first pkix-revocation mutation sweep, 2026-11-27: 276 mutants, 93
missed. 50 closed so far.
close_reason: Closed across 456187c3 (Display for Error and OutOfScopeReason, crl_reason_name, Error::source and its parse-error arm -- an in-crate module listing all 31 Error variants and all 6 scope reasons, asserting non-empty and pairwise distinct, with the RFC 5280 5.3.1 reason names written out as an independent oracle) and abb60fd1 (find_parent's conjunction and reaches_self_signed's step counter, the latter via a deadline-bounded thread because the mutation hangs rather than answering wrongly). enforce_direct_crl_domain's inner conjunction closed separately on the issuer path.
